one_line: A master Hoysala temple architect shaping Karnata Dravida stone marvels in 12th–13th century Karnataka.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, lean but sturdy craftsman’s build
appearance.face: oval face, medium-brown Deccan complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed moustache and short beard line along jaw, a small healed nick on left eyebrow, calm focused eyes with a thoughtful default expression
appearance.hair: thick black hair, center-parted and combed back into a small knotted bun at the back of the head, front kept tidy without bangs, wrapped with a narrow off-white cotton headband tied at the right temple
appearance.costume: knee-length deep indigo cotton angarkha-style tunic with side ties and a simple woven border, worn over a cream cotton dhoti wrapped to mid-calf with precise pleats; a muted rust-orange cotton shawl draped from left shoulder across chest and over right forearm; simple brown leather sandals; a thin gold chain at the neck and two plain copper bangles on the right wrist, all in modest artisan style of Hoysala-era Karnataka
appearance.signature: a smooth dark-grey chloritic schist block under his left hand and a long iron chisel in his right, paired with a wooden mallet hanging at his waist by a simple leather loop

ref_desc: Mid-30s Hoysala architect with medium-brown oval face, black knotted-bun hair and headband, wearing indigo tunic, cream dhoti, rust-orange shawl, brown sandals, gold chain, copper bangles, holding chisel and schist block in a deep indigo, cream and rust palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of a mid-30s Hoysala temple architect from 12th–13th century Karnataka: medium-brown oval face, calm focused eyes, straight nose, small nick on left eyebrow, neatly trimmed moustache and short jawline beard; black hair center-parted and combed back into a small knotted bun, with a narrow off-white cotton headband tied at the right temple. He wears a knee-length deep indigo cotton angarkha-style tunic with side ties and simple woven border, over a cream cotton dhoti wrapped to mid-calf with crisp pleats, a muted rust-orange cotton shawl draped from left shoulder across chest and over right forearm, simple brown leather sandals, a thin gold chain at the neck and two plain copper bangles on his right wrist. His right hand grips a long iron chisel, his left rests on a smooth dark-grey chloritic schist block, and a wooden mallet hangs at his waist on a leather loop. Show him front, three-quarter, and back views in consistent colors, emphasizing the indigo tunic, cream dhoti, rust-orange shawl, headband, tools and stone block as his defining elements.
